title: Dining in Paris
abstract: Dining in Paris is a culinary adventure filled with rich flavors and timeless traditions. From elegant Michelin-starred restaurants to cozy bistros, the city offers everything from gourmet French classics to innovative modern dishes. Enjoy flaky croissants and fresh pastries at a local bakery, or indulge in savory treats like coq au vin and escargot at a traditional brasserie. For a unique experience, explore the vibrant markets, where fresh ingredients inspire seasonal dishes. Dining in Paris isn’t just a meal; it’s a chance to savor the art and passion of French cuisine.

packages.title: Epicurean Experience at Le Cinq
packages.description: This package at the three-Michelin-starred Le Cinq restaurant at the Four Seasons Hotel George V includes a multi-course seasonal tasting menu, a private kitchen tour, and a curated wine pairing led by the head sommelier.

packages.title: Market and Dining Tour with Chef Alain Ducasse
packages.description: Begin with a market tour led by the acclaimed chef Alain Ducasse or a member of his team, picking out ingredients, then enjoy an intimate, three-course lunch prepared with those items at one of Ducasse’s prestigious restaurants.

packages.title: La Cuisine Paris Gastronomy Tour
packages.description: This food tour and cooking class package includes a walk through the historic Latin Quarter with stops at artisanal shops, a private cooking lesson to prepare a traditional French meal, and a tasting session with local wines and cheeses.

packages.title: Rooftop Dining Experience at L’Oiseau Blanc
packages.description: Enjoy an unforgettable evening at L’Oiseau Blanc with a five-course meal featuring modern French cuisine. This package includes a window table with spectacular views of the Eiffel Tower and a personal sommelier to curate your wine selections.

packages.title: Michelin-Starred Progressive Dinner
packages.description: Visit three Michelin-starred restaurants in a single evening, enjoying an appetizer, main course, and dessert at each location. The evening includes private transfers between venues and a guide who shares insights into the history of each establishment.

packages.title: Champagne Tasting Dinner at Le Meurice
packages.description: This package at Le Meurice offers an exquisite dinner with each course paired with a selection of rare champagnes. Hosted by an expert sommelier, the evening features a guided tasting of vintage bottles, with explanations of each pairing and the history behind each champagne.
